scenario: create the first tsconfig.json after an .mts HMR entry has loaded

initial_configs.parent: includes sub/**/* and claims the entry
initial_configs.nearer: files=[] and include=[]; does not claim the entry

ancestor_config_search.change: edit the nearer tsconfig to include **/*
ancestor_config_search.result: A nearer config that was skipped by OXC auto-discovery was still watched because it is part of the resolver's ancestor search.

result: The previously absent ancestor tsconfig.json was watched. Creating it triggered a conservative CLI restart and re-evaluated the entry in the same process.
scope: Focused runtime check on one macOS host. The measured latency is restart fallback latency, not the accepted-source-update latency claim.
